paragraphs: Nechemyah, son-in-law of the Nasi's household.
Mentioned in [Yoma 78a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.78a.3), where he said, “I saw R' Ami and R' Assi reach a channel of water and cross it wearing their footwear.”[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The linked passage names Nechemyah, son-in-law of the Nasi’s household, reporting what he saw Rabbi Ami and Rabbi Asi do. [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2659&lang=en) cites the same report.
The immediately preceding question concerns crossing water on Shabbat while wearing shoes. The Hebrew of the reported action says “while wearing” them.
The household designation is Nasi. The linked passage names Rabbi Ami and Rabbi Asi in full.
